mission: Audit real archived R5 scored choices, accepted casts, supported payoffs and bounded repeat/terminal outcomes for exact frozen Manual v0.7. Look for falsifiable wasted-loop or missed terminal opportunities without proposing unseen alternative game outcomes.
measurements: Unchanged R5 priority legal-action score/options vs actual accepted selection for casting each conversion card and activated Walking Ballista; count all original arms, seeds and seats.
Actual accepted SpellCast actions by sourceName, including source-matched SpellCastEvent. Distinguish offers from cards ever drawn/used and distinguish turn 1-3 from late windows.
Ancestral Statue BATTLEFIELD to HAND change with exact original event and finite per-turn cast counts; do not treat any loop as infinite without observed legal repeated actions.
Public observed DamageDealtEvent by Purphoros and Walking Ballista to players, plus original game terminal events in the same accepted action; report missing opportunities as zero, not failure.

Bind all actions and decisions against exact original ZIP, source SHA, no rejected results, no hidden opposition hand lookups. Select deterministic first example by cohort/seed/control-before-A/index, independent of outcome.
Do not attribute a game result or cEDH win rate to an offered but unselected spell, hypothetical future draw or scripted opponent pass.

classification.offered_and_not_chosen: historical scored option available; no proof strategic error
classification.same_action_damage_and_terminal: contemporaneous source event evidence, not general win rate
classification.finite_cast_chain: group actual accepted per caster and global turn; do not infer infinite loop from multiple casts
classification.missing_actual_combo: if no original observed route, keep v0.7 and use independent deterministic mechanics tests before claiming power

next_gate: If original opportunity and a legitimate better choice are demonstrable, predeclare a one-variable RACE challenger and source-bound replay. Otherwise report lack of observed deficiency and hold v0.7/R5 rather than forcing a card/policy change.
